title: Microsoft Intune: Administrator protection settings in the settings catalog and account protection template
summary: Hold: the control's Learn link documents generic policy creation but not the Administrator protection settings at the end of its path. The path is supported by another cited Microsoft page, so correcting the link resolves that blocker. Intune release notes also document Administrator protection in Account protection policies, which the briefing should acknowledge alongside the less complete reference page.
